trainingEnvironment: real BadugiGameController through JSONL Python bridge
initialCheckpoint: same isolated 2000-hand v2 Standard checkpoint used by first Pro diagnostic; initialization only
referencePolicy: published D03 v2 Standard ONNX; unchanged reference for bootstrap and imitation
hypothesis: The initial Pro run lost rare BET FOLD choices during DQN updates because an unstratified 64-decision reference anchor seldom samples them. The resulting excess calls plausibly reduced chip EV, but the same-state action audit alone is not causal EV evidence.
intervention: Collect more published Standard demonstrations on real-controller observations, then reserve 8 of 64 distinct reference decisions per imitation and per-hand anchor update for BET FOLD. DRAW index 0 is never counted as FOLD. Keep original checkpoint, exploration and environment unchanged.
diagnosticRule: Stop at 1200 total hands, inspect reference FOLD count, chip conservation and held-out same-observation action preservation, then independently compare on-policy 20-hand sessions on unused seeds against published Standard. Do not claim a causal paired EV comparison. If chip EV or reliability regresses, reject and investigate; no auto-continuation.
promotionRule: No registry or public asset change until separate preregistered product evaluation clears cash/MTT, 2/3/6 seats, opponent distributions, actual browser model use, legal action and amount, deadline and fallback; an exploratory improvement alone is insufficient.
safety: 5k remains a diagnostic stop gate only. S01 v2 remains stopped and other nine Standard games remain gated until all D03 tiers complete.
